tha-ap421:1.1: Patthodanadāyaka.] Vanacārī pure āsiṃ satataṃ vanakammiko / patthodanaṃ gahetvāna kammantam agamās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap421:2.1: Tatth' addasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ sayambhum aparājitaṃ / vanā piṇḍāya nikkhantaṃ disvā cittaṃ pasādayiṃ. // //
tha-ap421:3.1: Parakammāyane yutto puññañ ca me na vijjati / ayaṃ patthodanam atthi bhojayissām' ahaṃ muniṃ. // //
tha-ap421:4.1: Patthodanaṃ gahetvāna sayambhussa adās' ahaṃ / mama nijjhāyamānassa paribhuñji tadā muni. // //
tha-ap421:5.1: Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca / jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsam agacch' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap421:6.1: Chattiṃsakkhattuṃ devindo devarajjam akārayiṃ / tettiṃsakkhattuṃ rājā ca cakkavattī ahos' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap421:7.1: Padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ / sukhito yasavā homi patthodanass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap421:8.1: Bhavābhave saṃsaranto labhāmi amitaṃ dhanaṃ / bhoge me ūnatā n' atthi patthodanass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap421:9.1: Nadīsotapaṭibhāgā bhogā nibbattare mama / parimetuṃ na sakkomi patthodanass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap421:10.1: Imaṃ khāda imaṃ bhuñja imamhi sayane saya / tenāhaṃ sukhito homi patthodanass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap421:11.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi patthodanass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap421:15.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Patthodanadāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
